legal.title: Legal Structure & Compliance
legal.description: Skytz Consulting operates under Laurasia LLC (Wyoming, USA) as its strategic global base. We comply with all applicable European (including GDPR) and U.S. legal requirements. Philipp Hoffschröer serves as the executive partner for all DACH region mandates.

german.title: Working with German-Speaking Companies
german.description: We work with German-speaking companies by providing executive-level recruitment expertise with deep familiarity of the German market, business culture, and hiring standards.
german.details: Our work is delivered in German and English and is structured for international collaboration, allowing clients in Germany to access specialized recruiting support without the constraints of a locally bound provider.

swiss.title: Supporting Swiss Organizations
swiss.description: We support Swiss-based organizations by identifying and engaging qualified engineering professionals based in Germany who are open to cross-border career opportunities.
swiss.details: Our mandate focuses on sourcing, pre-qualifying, and advising candidates under German contractual and regulatory frameworks, while facilitating introductions to Swiss employers for roles where relocation or cross-border employment is initiated by the candidate.
swiss.benefit: This approach ensures full compliance on the sourcing side, a transparent process for all parties, and access to a highly relevant talent pool familiar with the Swiss market and working environment.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Skytz Consulting ("we", "us", "our") is a brand operated by Laurasia LLC. We are committed to protecting your privacy and processing personal data in compliance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and other applicable data protection laws.

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.description: The data controller responsible for your personal data is:

dataCollected.title: 2. Personal Data We Collect
dataCollected.intro: We collect and process the following categories of personal data:

items.contact: Contact information: name, email address, telephone number, company name, job title
items.email: Communication data: content of emails, messages, and any attachments you send us
items.technical: Technical data: IP address, browser type and version, time zone, operating system, access times
items.candidate: Professional data (for candidates): CV/resume, work history, qualifications, salary expectations
items.usage: Usage data: pages visited, time spent on pages, referral source

purpose.title: 3. Purpose of Processing
purpose.intro: We process your personal data for the following purposes:

items.inquiries: Responding to inquiries and providing information about our services
items.services: Performing recruitment services including candidate sourcing, evaluation, and placement
items.website: Operating, maintaining, and improving this website
items.legal: Complying with legal obligations and protecting our legal rights
items.communication: Communicating with you about relevant opportunities or services

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)
legalBasis.intro: For individuals in the European Economic Area (EEA), UK, and Switzerland, we process personal data on the following legal bases:

items.consent: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR): Where you have given explicit consent for specific processing activities
items.contract: Contractual necessity (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR): Where processing is necessary to perform a contract or take pre-contractual steps
items.legitimate: Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): Where processing is necessary for our legitimate business interests, such as direct marketing, fraud prevention, and service improvement
items.legal: Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR): Where processing is required to comply with applicable laws

sharing.title: 5. Data Sharing & International Transfers
sharing.description: We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with: (a) clients, solely for recruitment purposes and only with your consent; (b) service providers who assist our operations under strict confidentiality agreements; (c) authorities when required by law. Data may be transferred to the United States where Laurasia LLC is based. Such transfers are conducted in compliance with GDPR requirements, including the use of Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) where applicable.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.description: We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described, typically: (a) client and candidate data for the duration of our business relationship plus 6 years for legal compliance; (b) website usage data for up to 26 months; (c) communication records for 3 years after last contact. You may request earlier deletion subject to legal retention requirements.

rights.title: 7. Your Data Protection Rights
rights.description: Depending on your jurisdiction, you have the following rights: Right of access (to obtain a copy of your data), Right to rectification (to correct inaccurate data), Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten'), Right to restrict processing, Right to data portability, Right to object to processing, Right to withdraw consent at any time, Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. California residents have additional rights under CCPA, including the right to know what personal information is collected and the right to opt-out of the sale of personal information (we do not sell personal data).

security.title: 8. Data Security
security.description: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These include encryption, access controls, and regular security assessments.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies & Tracking
cookies.description: This website uses only essential cookies necessary for site functionality. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking services. Any analytics tools used are configured to anonymize IP addresses.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Material changes will be communicated via our website. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance.

contact.title: 11. Contact & Data Protection Inquiries
contact.description: For privacy-related inquiries, data subject requests, or complaints, please contact us at
